bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver"
test -d "$root" || exit 60
flags=0
command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1 && flags=$((flags+1))
command -v ffprobe >/dev/null 2>&1 && flags=$((flags+2))
if find "$root" -maxdepth 8 -type f \( -iname '*sticker*convert*' -o -iname '*sticker*process*' -o -iname '*tgs*lottie*' \) -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .;then flags=$((flags+4));fi
if find "$root" -maxdepth 7 -type d \( -iname '*CreateVdo*' -o -iname '*sticker*' \) -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .;then flags=$((flags+8));fi
exit $((80+flags))
